blocks.title: Push and pop
blocks.text: Before push, reject top==stack.Length-1 (full); before pop, reject top==-1 (empty). Push then increments top; pop reads then decrements it.

blocks.title: Queue array
blocks.text: rear tracks the newest item and front tracks the oldest.

blocks.title: Enqueue and dequeue
blocks.text: This linear queue uses rear as the last occupied index. Reject enqueue when rear==queue.Length-1 and dequeue when front>rear. Freed earlier slots are not reused; a circular queue later adds wraparound.

blocks.title: Worked example · Trace a stack
blocks.text: Push 8, push 7, then process an add operation. C# pointer connection: int[] stack = new int[5]; int top = -1; top++; stack[top] = 8; top++; stack[top] = 7; int first = stack[top]; top--; int second = stack[top]; top--; top++; stack[top] = first + second; push 8 push 7 pop → 7 pop → 8 push 15
